description: SessionStart (startup, clear) board-context injection (KAIROS-A-0014): emits the wiring of the folder (`kairos config show --json`: a [[project]] of config.toml; the retired .claude/kairos.local.md is not read, KAIROS-T-0742) as additionalContext, each value with its source, the Kairos rules (KAIROS-T-0525: at the start of a wired session, not only on the first Kairos call), and instructs the agent to pull live board state via the authenticated kairos MCP tools. Hooks hold no credentials (tokens live with the MCP client); offline degrades to a note. Silent no-op when nothing binds the folder; each error goes to stderr with exit 0 (KAIROS-T-0708). Stop: the Ralph loop (COLLIERY-T-1861) blocks the stop and gives the next step while a loop of this session is active (state in ~/.claude/kairos-ralph/<session_id>.json); no loop -> silent no-op. SessionStart `compact` + PostToolUse on the kairos item tools (COLLIERY-T-1862): after a compaction, active_work.py gives the agent its Active tasks, their initiatives and next steps, and the Ralph loop, from a local record per session (~/.claude/kairos-work/<session_id>.json), then the wiring summary (no probe) and the Kairos rules again (KAIROS-T-0525); with no wiring, the tasks of the record and the rules (KAIROS-T-0708); no Kairos read, no credentials. SessionStart (startup, clear) + PostToolUse on Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit (COLLIERY-T-1855): index_update.py starts `kairos index update --link-only` as a detached background job (no model, COLLIERY-T-2529; KAIROS_INDEX_SUMMARIZE=1 runs the model; no wait; skipped when `kairos` is not on PATH or `kairos config show` does not bind the checkout), tells the agent to use the code tools of the kairos-code MCP server before it reads files, and keeps a list of edited source files that the background job logs and clears after a successful update (state and log in ~/.claude/kairos-index/<name>-<hash>/). The job writes last-update.json (exit code, refusal); when the last update failed, the next start and the compaction give the agent one line with the refusal and the command to run again (KAIROS-T-0519). The record hook keys the list by the checkout of the edited file (the nearest folder with .git; in a board folder, each clone or worktree), records nothing outside a git checkout, and starts a detached debounced update for that checkout: one per checkout at a time (debounce.lock), 30 s after the last edit (KAIROS_INDEX_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS, `off` for none) (KAIROS-T-0524). PreToolUse (COLLIERY-I-0631): kairos_rules.py gives the Kairos rules once per session on the first Kairos tool call (marker ~/.claude/kairos-rules/<session_id>-<version>; short codes as links when deployment_url is wired); git_guard.py on Bash asks before git push, merge, rebase, tag, reset --hard, commit --amend, --force, gh pr merge and gh release; it asks every time, but for the push of a feature branch to origin (KAIROS-T-0542: one local branch, not the default branch, not a tag, no force). PreToolUse on Write|Edit|MultiEdit (COLLIERY-I-0628): memory_reminder.py reminds, once per session per file, that a fact about the system belongs in Kairos (an ADR, the spec, a note on the initiative) when the file is in a .claude/projects/*/memory/ folder or CLAUDE_MEMORY_DIR; it never blocks and reads no memory text. PreToolUse on Write|Edit|MultiEdit (KAIROS-T-0702, COLLIERY-I-0659): adr_context.py gives, once per session per file, the ADRs that the file cites (code, title, column, successor, amendments) from `kairos adrs check <file> --json`, in a wired checkout only, with the states cached per session (~/.claude/kairos-adr/<session_id>.json); it fails open: a file that cites nothing, no CLI, no deployment or any error gives no output, and it never blocks.
